title: Strongbox

sources.title: Strongbox
markers: '''Strongbox''' is a type of Static Clutter [[Container]] that can be found throughout [[Act Three]] of the game. Usually contains valuable items and requires {{Ability check|Sleight of Hand|15}} to lockpick.

fields.Lock: Typically holds valuables. DC 15 Sleight of Hand unless you have the applicable key.
fields.Base value: No nominal value is listed in the pinned item source.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and exact item and dependency citations.
